shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for panels meant to read as raised.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA button, fully rounded with brand glow.
components.css: .btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; background: #00e599; color: #04140d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,229,153,0.4), 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0,229,153,0.5); transition: all 200ms; } .btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(0,229,153,0.9); } .btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e5e8ec; background: #ffffff; transition: all 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(0,229,153,0.3); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15,23,42,0.06), 0 24px 48px -20px rgba(15,23,42,0.24); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field used across contact/lead forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e8ec; background: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #00e599; }

narrative.overview: EcoStorage is pay-as-you-use, secure, hassle-free storage — customers never touch a facility, and the site's job is to make that promise feel instantly credible. The base surface stays clean, white, and unhurried, so trust-building content reads with total clarity. Brand green is a confident, recurring signal threaded through icons, stats, active states, and dividers so the sustainability story stays visually present throughout. The voice is approachable and warm rather than clinical: rounded-full buttons and rounded-xl cards soften the logistics-company edge, while numeric content is set in tabular figures for precision. Depth is structural, not ambient — surfaces sit flat at rest and shadows only appear as direct feedback to hover/focus.
keyCharacteristics: Clean white base canvas with brand green as a confident, recurring signal
Rounded, tactile forms over sharp geometry
Numbers always set in tabular figures for a precise, trustworthy feel
Shadows appear only in response to interaction
No stock photography — empty media slots use skeleton shimmer

rules.name: The Recurring Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Mint is allowed to repeat across a single screen because the color itself carries meaning (trust + sustainability); it should never become the dominant surface color.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any live/computed numeric value is set with tabular-nums so digits don't shift width as values change.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow only appears where the user's attention or action just landed (hover, focus, primary CTA). Flat surfaces stay flat until then.

dos: Do use Signal Mint repeatedly and confidently across a screen — stats, CTAs, active states, dividers.
Do set every computed/live numeric value in tabular-nums.
Do keep all corners rounded — no sharp corners.
Do keep shadows flat at rest and only introduce them on hover/focus.
donts: Don't hardcode stock photography, illustrations, or video — media slots stay empty placeholders.
Don't apply shadow-card as an always-on ambient shadow.
Don't introduce a second display typeface or serif pairing.
Don't disclose specific warehouse/facility locations in any UI copy or design artifact.
